authorization: User requested larger-encoder sweep jointly with a narrower LR range after finding a good learning rate.
boundary_rule: If the selected broad-sweep rate is on its boundary, call it a candidate, not a bracketed optimum. If the best local endpoint lies at a local-grid boundary or a rate fails numerically, review/extend the local range before final encoder selection; preserve every attempted result.
controls: Same two 3x3 convolutions with per-point RMSNorm and SiLU for the width comparison; stride1/SAME, 36 overlapping 2x2 patches, 34 causal layers, width768, original cached decode runtime, full histories, same initial seed and exact episode/D4 draws, one policy head, no BN, same 1024-update schedule and test split closed. All changed parameter shapes and MLP compensation are disclosed.
evidence_status: Analytical feasibility only. Encoder arithmetic is anchored to both frozen linear and conv64 traces; candidates have not been implemented, independently traced or TPU-qualified.
mlp_selection: Among widths divisible by8 and <=2304, choose the parameter count closest to the existing conv64 transformer while satisfying the original CNN parameter and decoding-budget tolerances. These discrete widths can introduce hardware padding.
prerequisite: Complete and audit all four registered LR endpoints, then inspect stability and choose the lowest final validation KL rate as L_star. No larger-encoder TPU job overlaps the active LR sweep.
required_before_training: Clone and freeze a separate capacity recipe without changing current source snapshots.
Verify parameter schema, independent encoder forward/gradient, causality, full-prefix/cache equivalence, and exact initialization of unchanged parameter shapes.
Trace all complete decoding operations, including encoder and pending action; recheck the original matching tolerance.
Measure actual TPU padding, latency, memory and full training buckets before declaring a candidate qualified.
Freeze exact LR configurations after the completed LR selection and publish the concrete bounded run registration.
Provide enough persistent checkpoint space using verified retention/restore procedures before launching further learning runs.
selection_scope: Fixed-data learnability and within-range LR selection, one seed. Compare matched-rate results and each architecture best in the same local grid. No convergence, MFU, Go-strength or RL-efficiency conclusion.
stage_order: Finish the current broad LR sweep.
Establish a local LR comparison for the width64 control at L_star/sqrt(2), L_star, L_star*sqrt(2), reusing any identical audited cell.
Evaluate width128 at the same three rates; inspect the complete fixed-horizon curves and common-rate comparisons.
Proceed to width256 only after reviewing width128. Keep the depth option separate for a later intervention.
